tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Return the official contact channels for turva.dev, including email, Signal, LinkedIn and the postal address. Engagement is async only, so there is no phone number and no meeting booking.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Return the services offered by turva.dev (audit, advisory, implementation, MCP server security test, agent operations, MCP server design) as the full services page in markdown, together with fixed prices in EUR for the three priced services and the active security testing add-on to the audit, quoted on request.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Return the registered business details for turva.dev: trading name, the operator who does the work, the Finnish Business ID, the country and city of registration, and the LinkedIn profile.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search the turva.dev page index for guides, blog posts and pages whose title matches a query, and return each match as a title with the page URL and the markdown URL of the same page. Read-only, and it reads the published llms.txt index rather than a separate search service.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the markdown twin of one page on turva.dev, as served for Accept: text/markdown. It carries the main content of the page. The frame around it, such as the Sources checked day of a guide, is only in the HTML. Takes a path on this site, for example /guides/llms-txt or /agent-readiness-audit. Read-only. The path is resolved against this site and anything that resolves to another origin is refused, so the tool cannot be pointed elsewhere.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to a named page on turva.dev, so the person sees it. Accepts one of the named pages only, never a URL, and it never leaves this site. Use get_page instead when you only need to read the text.
